title: The detail-only lint never fires for a gate added with the default kind, since --kind blocking is itself a block reason
goal: bl_authority.detail_only ignores an explicit or default --kind blocking as a block reason while keeping every other one, so gate add and precheck SP print detail only beside a default-kind gate that asks only an implementation detail; review gap G3.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t,os; d=t.mkdtemp(); r=lambda *a, env=None: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env); i=r("new","story","--title","S","--goal","g","--touch","src/a.py").stdout.split()[2]; p=r("gate","add",i,"--question","Which columns does the table hold?","--option","one table","--option","two tables","--recommendation","one table"); sys.exit("a default-kind detail gate gets no detail-only line: "+p.stdout[-200:] if "detail only" not in p.stdout else 0)
